messages:
Noah (Finance): FYI MediCore flagged their renewal quote: platform fee discount for their 3-yr commit not applied to the on-prem connector SKU. Can billing confirm?
Aisha (Billing): Pulling the quote. I see discount code 'MC-3YR-15' applied to subscription lines but not to SKU ONPREM-CONN. Looks like our quoting rule excludes hardware/add-on SKUs.
Carlos (Sales Ops): Customer negotiated 15% off total ARR including that connector in the SOW. Sales attached the signed SOW to the opp (opp-78321). We should honor it.
Jin (Legal): Confirmed SOW language: "platform fees and add-on connectors included in committed ARR". Legal ok with discount as long as we issue amendment for multi-year pricing.
Aisha (Billing): Quick calculation snapshot:
```
sku,qty,unit_price,subtotal
ONPREM-CONN,1,12000,12000
PLATFORM-DEDICATED,1,48000,48000
SUBTOTAL, , ,60000
15%_DISCOUNT_EXPECTED, , ,-9000
EXPECTED_TOTAL, , ,51000
CURRENT_QUOTE_TOTAL, , ,60000
```
The connector wasn't discounted, gap = $1800.
Noah (Finance): Gap seems small but affects ARR reporting for the FY close — need crediting path and corrected renewal for the account. Also note customer pays in EUR; our FX conversion used a stale rate which inflated connector line by ~€200.
Carlos (Sales Ops): Ugh FX. They indicated they'd pay in EUR during negotiations. Which rate did we use?
Aisha (Billing): Our quoting engine used master rate from 2025-03-01 (1 USD = 0.92 EUR). The sales quote used live rate 1 USD = 0.95 EUR. That explains ~€240 difference on the connector.
Noah (Finance): Action plan: 1) issue $1,800 one-time credit for missed discount (credit memo), 2) regenerate renewal quote with corrected FX/discount, 3) publish amendment for 3-yr commit reflecting corrected totals for signature, 4) create internal remediation ticket to include add-on SKUs in discount scope for Promo MC-3YR-15. Approve?
Carlos (Sales Ops): Approve. Also ping customer that numbers will be updated before their renewal call tomorrow.
Jin (Legal): I'll draft a short amendment template and add countersign block.
Aisha (Billing): Creating credit memo now -> CM-5921. Corrected quote queued (quote-99821). Opening billing ticket BILL-8530 to change promo scope and FX source.
InvoiceBot: Credit memo CM-5921 created by Aisha at 2012350420. Quote quote-99821 status -> pending_approval.
Noah (Finance): Please tag the credit as 'one-time adjustment - negotiated discount' so ARR reconciliation excludes it from recurring ARR. Close loop once quote signed.
Carlos (Sales Ops): I'll email MediCore with the corrected proforma and proposed amendment PDF. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
